description: Defines the NetworkDelegate interface for handling network request events and policies in Chromium's net module.

classes.name: net::NetworkDelegate
classes.description: Interface for handling network request lifecycle events and policies, including request modification, cookie handling, privacy, and reporting.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is sent; can modify the request URL.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeStartTransaction
methods.description: Called before the network transaction starts; can modify headers.

methods.name: NotifyHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received; can override headers.

methods.name: NotifyCompleted
methods.description: Called when request completes or fails.

methods.name: AnnotateAndMoveUserBlockedCookies
methods.description: Allows blocking cookies based on policies.

methods.name: CanSetCookie
methods.description: Determines if a cookie can be set.

methods.name: ForcePrivacyMode
methods.description: Determines privacy mode for a request.

methods.name: CancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Cancels request if referrer policy is violated.

methods.name: CanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if reporting report can be queued.

methods.name: CanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Checks if reporting reports can be sent.

methods.name: CanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if reporting client can be set.

methods.name: CanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if reporting client can be used.

methods.name: GetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cache filter info for first-party sets.
